title: What the Snow Leopard means

is_this_you.pressure: Hurt, you climb. You go up past the last trees and let the valley guess what happened.
is_this_you.love: You can watch someone from the far ridge for a whole season. Then you walk beside them for a week, close enough to touch.
is_this_you.cost: You keep so still up there that the people who love you start counting you as gone.

opener.text: A monk once painted Milarepa, the eleventh-century yogi, as a snow leopard leading his disciples [s8]. In Bhutan many tales say great lamas crossed between Tibet and Bhutan in that shape [s8]. The body changes. The mind stays. You know something about that.

tabs.label: Above the line
tabs.intro: Water and Earth, both facing inward.

rows.text: Scorpio is fixed Water, a feminine sign [s1]. The Goat is yin Earth [s3]. The Chinese guides call the Goat gentle and private, with few close friends [s4] [s5]. Scorpio adds depth, and it is slow to forgive [s1] [s2]. So you live high, apart, and hard to move.

rows.k: The snow leopard does it too
rows.text: The snow leopard lives mostly on wild goats and sheep, the ibex, argali, blue sheep and markhor [s6]. A Goat-year animal that hunts goats. You know the gentle ones from the inside. That is why you read them before they speak.
In Ladakh the cat is called jatpo, the one who stalks [s9]. Nobody hears you coming either. Most days you are only coming to sit nearby.

tabs.label: The hunt you share
tabs.intro: Long distance. Then a short, close season.

rows.text: Wild snow leopard pairs travel together for one to eight days, mostly within ten meters of each other [s11]. That is your courtship. Mating pairs have even been recorded hunting together [s6]. Once you share the work of living with someone, you have already chosen.

Give yourself hard ground and a long hold. Audit and fieldwork pay for patience that proves itself later. In Bhutan villagers call the snow leopard a fence [s8]. You guard a small territory, and you guard it well.

tabs.label: Who finds you
tabs.intro: Three who make the climb, one who pulls you down.
tabs.love_lead: You do not go looking. The right ones climb up and sit down without asking for anything. The old Chinese pairings name three who can.

easy.why: The Green Sea Turtle (Cancer, Horse year) is your secret friend, since the Horse is the Goat's hidden ally, and Cancer shares Scorpio's Water [s3] [s1].
The Sea Otter (Cancer, Rabbit year) sits in your trine of Rabbit, Goat and Pig, and swims in the same Water [s3] [s1].
The Mountain Pygmy Possum (Capricorn, Rabbit year) is trine kin from the high country, with Capricorn's Earth to bank your Water [s3].

hard.why: The hard one is the Giant Clam: the Ox clashes with the Goat, and Taurus sits opposite Scorpio [s3] [s1].

story.text: In Ladakh they tell of a yogi in a cave who fed a snow leopard. It was a deity in animal form. The next morning a fresh kill lay at the cave mouth, left as thanks [s9].

closing: You leave the gift and say nothing. The mountain keeps the rest.
